title: How the Owens Daily Wire firing-reason dispute developed
summary: Tracks the firing explanation, quoted rebuttal, document excerpts and disclosure position presented on channel, without establishing the actual grounds for termination or document authenticity.

milestones.label: Genocide firing account
milestones.proposition: Owens presents her account that Boreing fired her for saying genocide is always wrong and is now misleading the public about that reason.
milestones.review_note: Reviewed 1984–2075s. This is the entry account in this reviewed thread, not a claim that it is her first public allegation. Statement-8e322225e98c repeats the account in a viewer comment; the viewer’s identity and underlying firing motive are not independently established.

milestones.label: Firing excerpt presented
milestones.proposition: Responding to the quoted challenge, Owens reads what she identifies as her firing document, saying it cites her tweet and her refusal to deny an interpretation that Israel was committing genocide.
milestones.review_note: Reviewed 2101–2296s with statements-656e4596f797, -791e286206b4 and -a6c0bc870eb4. The excerpt is documentary support as presented by Owens, not an authenticated complete termination record or proof of sole causation. A second excerpt concerns Christians killed by Israel; its spoken October 7, 2024 date is preserved in canonical evidence and is not corrected or adopted here. Her claimed proportionate-response clause is an attributed explanation of limited disclosure, not a legal finding.
milestones.statement_text: Owens cited her firing document as including her tweet and stating that she insinuated Israel was committing genocide and refused to explicitly deny that interpretation.
milestones.speaker: Candace Owens

It says you have insinuated that you believe Israel is committing a genocide and refuse to explicitly deny that interpretation, meaning someone else interpreted it that way and it was incumbent upon me to.

milestones.label: Full disclosure invited
milestones.proposition: Owens publicly says the other side has her permission to release all firing documents and that there are no holdups on her end.
milestones.review_note: Reviewed 3029–3045s alongside her limited-proportionate-response explanation at 2101–2146s / statement-656e4596f797. This distinguishes her own stated disclosure restriction from her invitation to the other side to publish the full file. No documents are shown released in this passage; permission does not establish a legal waiver or lift obligations binding anyone else.

links.review_note: The quoted reply directly challenges the commenter’s repetition of the firing explanation Owens has just stated. It disputes that account without supplying a full competing termination narrative; neither party’s truthfulness is adjudicated.

Owens explicitly introduces the firing-document excerpt to answer Boreing’s quoted denial, adding a document-based account of what was cited in termination. Partial excerpts can bear on the dispute but do not establish completeness, authenticity or exclusive cause.

Having shown selected excerpts and described limits on her own response, Owens invites the other side to release the full file. This advances the disclosure position without treating an invitation as an actual release or a legal resolution.
